name: fillet-ring-closes-on-itself
why: A fillet all the way round a bead's rim is one B-spline face closed by a seam, and OpenCASCADE's check of a face against itself (BOPAlgo_CheckerSI, one-surface IntPatch walk) seeded a walk from the triangles on either side of that seam, which share no node, and reported the seam as the face crossing itself: 0.1 and 0.15 mm here on arm64, 0.2 mm on x86_64 Windows (the v0.0.14 release corpus), the other radii clear; the rings' surfaces close to 1e-9 mm and a 0.002 mm mesh of the flagged ring has no two triangles crossing. The wrapper now judges the walked points: both preimages inside the face and not both on a seam (docs/GOTCHAS.md, "A closed fillet ring was reported as crossing itself at its seam"). Volume is the bare union's 2152.326 plus what sixteen concave rounds fill.
